=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Retarget to the default branch using `WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH`, then the event's default branch, then `main`" — the script's resolution order is documented in the PR description and in the script's own comment, and the script honors it via `HEAL_RETARGET_BRANCH="${PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-${WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-}}"` plus the GITHUB_EVENT_PATH `.repository.default_branch` lookup plus the final `main` fallback.
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml` — the `intake` job environment block (around line 90, alongside the existing `WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH` export) needs a `WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ vars.WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH || '' }}` entry so the repo variable reaches the script.
  Evidence of absence: The script reads `WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH` at `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:432` (provenance block) and `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1439` (new retarget block), and documents the variable at `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:89-91`. The workflow at `.github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:78-99` exports `WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED`, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_TARGET_BRANCH`, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SELF_INFLICTED_ROUTING_ENABLED`, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REQUIRE_REPORT_AUTH`, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_REPORT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`, etc., but no `WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH`. Without the export, the `${WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-}` expansion is always empty in workflow runs, so the operator-configured override is silently ignored — the retarget falls through to the `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` event branch (which works for this repo but is the wrong contract for any repo whose default branch is not `main`, and which is also wrong for repos whose event payload's `default_branch` does not match the heal target they want). The four new tests in `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py` only inject `WORKFLOW_HEAL_DEFAULT_BRANCH` through `extra_env`, so they cannot catch this wiring gap.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
